schedule.title: Schedule
help.intro: Copy the link with the Copy button and add it in your calendar app by hand:
help.google.after: in a browser (on a phone, switch to the desktop site) and paste the link. The calendar then appears in the app on your phone too; if it doesn't, turn on Sync for it in the app's settings. Google refreshes such calendars rarely, up to once a day.
help.apple: on a Mac: File → New Calendar Subscription; on an iPhone: Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar.
